name: Polymyxin B
executiveSummary: Polymyxin B. Adult IV: **1.5–2.5 mg/kg/day** every 12 h. Pediatrics PO (decolonization): **10–20 mg/kg/day**. NICU IV reserve: **1.5–2.5 mg/kg/day** divided every 12 h — infectious diseases.
indications:
## Indications

- Resistant Gram-negative infections (IV); selected preoperative PO decolonization (± metronidazole).

## Precautions

- Nephro- and neurotoxicity. Confirm local vial units↔mg conversion.

> Reserve / infectious diseases use.

adulto.dose: 1.5–2.5 mg/kg/day IV divided every 12 h (convert units to mg per package insert).

pediatrico.notes: Contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity reactions to polymyxins.

neonatal.presentation: Vial 500,000–1,000,000 units; conversion per package insert.
neonatal.dose: IV (reserve): **1.5–2.5 mg/kg/day** divided every **12 h**; adjust in CKD — infectious diseases/NICU only.

stability:
## Stability

- Use after dilution per package insert.
adverseEffects:
## Adverse effects

Irritability, ataxia, perioral paresthesia, nephrotoxicity.
